attempts.summary: Configured NFS share on node1 (/srv/nfs/shared) exported to node2, mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, with shared dataops identity (UID/GID 4500) and dataops:dataops ownership, mode 2770, on both systems. Cross-node write consistency verified. Both nodes restarted one at a time (node1 then node2) with confirmed changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of NFS server/export and client mount with data intact.
